basic_info.description: Stunning 1930's Spanish Revival home in Old Miraloma Park. 305 Juanita is a fully detached property on an oversized corner lot w/ 4 bedrooms, 2.5 bathrooms, period details & hardwood floors. Surrounded by lush, mature landscaping, this beautifully renovated home is the ideal blend of indoor-outdoor living. The main level features large rooms w/ a seamless flow, including 2 bedrooms & 1.5 baths. The living room offers fantastic light, barrel vaulted ceilings, grand arched picture window, built-ins & fireplace. The cross vaulted formal dining room w/ City outlooks is perfect for entertaining. Open kitchen/great room w/ quartzite counters, pantry, high-end appliances, center island & breakfast alcove. Direct access to the backyard from the kitchen w/ large patio & basketball court area. The lower level includes a primary suite w/ walk-in closet & bathroom w/ double sinks & shower. A fourth bedroom & laundry room w/ new washer & dryer complete this floor. The massive 2 car garage consists of a 300 sq. ft. storage room, closets & wine cellar.  The home's renovation was completed in 2017- all new plumbing, electrical, roof & new windows in nearly every room. Great location w/ ample parking, easy access to Downtown, 280/101, parks, shops, restaurants, excellent schools, BART and MUNI.
